DROP = fear_rotation: shares are down ~34-37% from late-2024 highs, yet fundamentals are accelerating — Q1 2026 revenue +21% YoY, record FY2025 revenue/NI/FCF, ~77% operating margins, +29% royalty production growth, net cash balance sheet, and an optional data-center/surface-monetization upside. The decline reflects multiple compression from a very high base (mid-2024 froth + index-inclusion unwind), softer oil-price sentiment and rotation out of high-multiple energy/royalty names — not deterioration of the underlying business. Classified fear_rotation (with a valuation-reset component) rather than genuine_deterioration.
